verdict.rationale: Rollbar docs confirm owner assignment (rollbar-docs-13) and four statuses—Active, Resolved, Muted, Archived (rollbar-docs-12)—covering resolve/ignore-like states, but there is no explicit 'snooze' concept and no documentation confirming that a resolved item automatically reopens when the error regresses. missing for 10: explicit snooze feature, documented auto-reopen-on-regression behavior, independent/hands-on confirmation of triage workflow.
